script_text: Stop! Capricorn, Saturn your ruling planet is locking you in a harsh square to Venus in your 5th House of romance. This earth-sign tension drags Mercury retrograde through your 8th House of shared resources, stirring old debts and secrets. If single, a slow seduction under restrained energy draws a serious suitor; if taken, avoid cold silences that trigger resentment. Your 10th House of career clashes with Mars, so delay signing contracts and protect your reputation from a rival's jab. Blessing: a surprise refund lands in your account by dusk. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
